definition: [ שֵׂט , סֵט ] noun [masculine] swerver, revolter (?), deeds that swerve (from the right?); — plural וְשַׁחֲטָה שֵׂטִים הֶעֱמִיקוּ Hos 5:2 and revolters have gone deep is slaughter (or שַׁחֲתָה in corruption ), but dubious; We Bae Now GASm , compare Gu Kau, {abbrev } וְשַׁחַת הַשִּׁטִּים הֶע and the pit of Shittim they have made deep ; עֲשׂה סֵטִים Ps 101:3 to do deeds that swerve I hate.
